definitions.gloss: every time, each time, each occasion
definitions.explanation: On each and every occasion that something happens. Emphasizes consistent repetition across multiple instances.

examples.japanese: {毎回|まいかい}⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I make the same mistake every time.

examples.japanese: {毎回|まいかい}⟦{遅刻|ちこく}する→遅刻する：22282_chikokusuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧はやめてほしい。
examples.english: I wish you would stop being late every time.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{毎回|まいかい}⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦ゲスト→ゲスト：10849_gesuto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出演|しゅつえん}→出演：11732_shutsuen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{飽|あ}きない→飽きる：01815_akiru⟧。
examples.english: This drama features a different guest each episode, so it never gets boring.

notes:
USAGE:
Used adverbially at the beginning of a clause or before the verb. Part of the ⟦{毎|まい}→毎〜：03968_mai⟧〜 series: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧ (every day), ⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧ (every week), ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧ (every month), ⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧ (every year), {毎回|まいかい} (every time).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧: always (broader — covers habitual states, not just repeated events)
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧たび⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: each time (emphasizes the consequence that follows each occurrence)
